test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six sisters Anu, Ankita, Asha, Amy, Anveshi and Aisha are sitting around a circular table facing each other. Anu sits to the immediate left of Ankita. Amy sits exactly between Asha and Aisha. Aisha does not sit adjacent to Anveshi who sits second to the right of Anu. Who sits to the immediate right of Ankita?
solution: Given: Six sisters Anu, Ankita, Asha, Amy, Anveshi and Aisha. 1) Anu sits to the immediate left of Ankita. 2) Aisha does not sit adjacent to Anveshi who sits second to the right of Anu.
